title: Immune-mediated Cognitive Impairment for Adults With NMOSD
official: Immune-mediated Cognitive Impairment for Adults With NMOSD
summary: This study will investigate how immune-mediated disorders (chronic inflammation, infections, autoimmune disorders) impact cognitive function and neural tissue damage. The investigators will connect immune activation with cognitive function and MRI changes in patients using clinical data, markers of inflammation, cognitive testing and MRI changes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* NMOSD Diagnosis with and without cognitive dysfunction
* All genders
* Age 18 or older
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age less than 17 years old
* Contraindications for participating in research studies
* Currently in ICU, are paralyzed, or have disorders that can cause permanent cognitive impairment
* Individuals who cannot consent to research on their own
* Non-English speaking
